skills.name: Health
skills.description: Increases current and max HP by 10 per rank.

skills.name: Constitution
skills.description: Increases health regeneration by 0.1 per rank.

skills.name: Weapon Damage
skills.description: Increases damage dealt by any attack (melee, ranged, or unarmed) by 1 per rank.

skills.name: Light Armor Training
skills.description: Allows the use of light armor.

skills.name: Medium Armor Training
skills.description: Allows the use of medium armor.

skills.name: Heavy Armor Training
skills.description: Allows the use of heavy armor.

skills.name: Iron Grip
skills.description: Reduces the TP cost of climbing (fort ramparts and similar) and lowers the chance of a failed climb in combat. Stacks with other climbing skills.

skills.name: Shove
skills.description: Grants the Shove action, pushing an adjacent enemy 1 hex away.

skills.name: Protector
skills.description: Reaction: Use your Sword/Dagger Parry to protect an adjacent ally from an attack.

skills.name: Battle Reflexes
skills.description: Passive: Gain 1 Time Point every time you are attacked.

skills.name: Time Point Rate
skills.description: Increases time points gained per tick by 0.05 per rank.

skills.name: Fast Movement
skills.description: Reduces move TP cost by 1 if wearing light or no armor. Stacks with Swift Step.

skills.name: Riding
skills.description: Allows mounting and riding animals of appropriate size.

skills.name: Nature Riding
skills.description: Allows mounting and riding animals of appropriate size.

skills.name: Divine Riding
skills.description: Allows mounting and riding animals of appropriate size.

skills.name: Sidestep
skills.description: Spend 6 TP to move to an adjacent hex when an opponent moves next to you. Requires light armor or no armor.

skills.name: Sidestep Mastery
skills.description: Reduces Sidestep TP cost by 1.

skills.name: Inconspicuous
skills.description: Grants +5 bonus to stealth checks.

skills.name: Keen Perception
skills.description: A sharp eye for what others miss — +10 per rank to the roll for spotting a stealthed opponent, and to the same kind of roll made passively against secret doors and other hidden objects as you pass near them.

skills.name: Sure-Footed
skills.description: Reduces the TP cost of climbing (fort ramparts and similar) and lowers the chance of a failed climb in combat. Stacks with other climbing skills.

skills.name: Shield Proficiency
skills.description: Reduces damage taken by an additional 1 when a shield is equipped.

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.description: Reaction: If an opponent attacks and misses, spend 3 TP to perform a basic attack (no weapon/skill bonuses).

skills.name: Shield Other
skills.description: Reaction: If an adjacent ally is attacked, spend 1 TP to apply your shield reduction to them.

skills.name: Quick Recovery
skills.description: Reduces turn-end threshold by 1 per rank (max 20).

skills.name: Initiative Bonus
skills.description: Start each combat with 5 TP per rank (max 10).

skills.name: Dagger Quick Draw
skills.description: Automatically equip another dagger from inventory after throwing.

skills.name: Shadow Weaver
skills.description: Grants +5 bonus to stealth checks.

skills.name: Subtle Spell
skills.description: Lets you build any known non-damaging spell as Subtle (+6 mana, +5 TP): casting it no longer breaks your stealth.

skills.name: Speedy Stealth
skills.description: Passive: Reduces the Time Point penalty of moving while stealthed by 2.

skills.name: Regeneration
skills.description: 20% chance to heal 1 HP per tick.

skills.name: Unarmed Proficiency
skills.description: Grants +5% hit chance when fighting unarmed.

skills.name: Unarmed Mastery
skills.description: Grants +2 damage when fighting unarmed.

skills.name: Pressure Point Strike
skills.description: Passive: When you hit an opponent with an unarmed attack, they cannot take reactions until they next take an action.

skills.name: Deflect Arrows
skills.description: React to deflect ranged attacks if unarmored and having an open hand. Works like Parry.

skills.name: Siphoning Palm
skills.description: An unarmed hit drains 1 mana per rank (max 3) from the target into you.

skills.name: Swift Step
skills.description: Reduces move TP cost by 1 if wearing no armor and no shield. Stacks with Fast Movement.

skills.name: Counter Trip
skills.description: Reaction: If an opponent attacks you and misses, spend 2 TP to make a trip attempt.

skills.name: Agile Climber
skills.description: Reduces movement TP penalty when moving up or down terrain levels. Also reduces the TP cost of climbing (fort ramparts and similar) and lowers the chance of a failed climb in combat — stacks with other climbing skills.

skills.name: Disarm
skills.description: Active: Attempt to disarm an opponent (50% base chance). (5 TP)

skills.name: Arcane Expansion
skills.description: Increase the radius of Arcane AOE spells by 1 per rank. (+10 mana per increase)

skills.name: Divine Expansion
skills.description: Increase the radius of Divine AOE spells by 1 per rank. (+10 mana per increase)

skills.name: Nature Expansion
skills.description: Increase the radius of Nature AOE spells by 1 per rank. (+10 mana per increase)

skills.name: Arcane Burst
skills.description: Lets you cast single-target Arcane damage spells (e.g. Firebolt) as an area burst centered on a point instead, at radius 1 for +8 mana. Arcane Expansion increases the radius further.

skills.name: Divine Burst
skills.description: Lets you cast single-target Divine damage or heal spells (e.g. Smite Evil, Heal) as an area burst centered on a point instead, at radius 1 for +8 mana. Divine Expansion increases the radius further.

skills.name: Nature Burst
skills.description: Lets you cast single-target Nature damage or heal spells as an area burst centered on a point instead, at radius 1 for +8 mana. Nature Expansion increases the radius further.

skills.name: Nature Touch

skills.name: Tiger Summoning

skills.name: Eagle Summoning

skills.name: Keen Elf Sight

skills.name: Elf Bow Mastery

skills.name: Elf Darkvision
skills.description: Reduces vision penalties and stealth detection penalties in low light.

skills.name: Woodland Stride
skills.description: Reduced movement cost, improved stealth, and improved defense while in foliage terrain. (Anti-requisite: Druid Foliage Mastery)

skills.name: Foliage Mastery
skills.description: Reduced movement cost, improved stealth, and improved defense while in foliage terrain. (Anti-requisite: Woodland Stride)

skills.name: Forager
skills.description: Extra yield when foraging fruit/herbs/fish. (Requires Knowledge: Nature)

skills.name: Ranger
skills.description: Grants +5 to-hit against animal-tagged enemies. (Requires Knowledge: Nature)

skills.name: Knowledge: Religion
skills.description: Training in scripture, ritual, and the theory behind divine and forbidden magic alike — lets you recognize what others would dismiss as mere grave-robbing or superstition.

skills.name: Solid as a Rock

skills.name: Opportunist
skills.description: Deals +3 damage against a target that is caught off-guard.

skills.name: Keen Senses
skills.description: Increases vision range by 3.

skills.description: Reduced vision/stealth-detection penalties in low light — same effect as elf Darkvision, a goblin trait from a life spent in warrens and caves.

skills.name: Momentum

skills.name: Relentless

skills.name: Divine Drain
skills.description: Whenever your trigger spells activate, the target loses 1 mana immediately per rank.

skills.name: Clouded Mind

skills.name: Feeble Strike
skills.description: Whenever your trigger spells activate, reduce target damage dealt by 1 per rank (stacks 3x).

skills.name: Severed Grace
skills.description: Whenever your trigger spells activate, reduce incoming healing by 50% per rank (Max 100%).

skills.name: Assassinate

skills.name: Sneak Attack

skills.name: Animal Companion
skills.description: Passive: Your Nature summons become permanent animal companions. (Max 1)

skills.name: Unicorn Bond
skills.description: Allows a unicorn to answer your call for a permanent animal companion — a trust earned from the druids of the grove, not bought with skill points.

skills.name: Poison Bite

skills.name: Life Drain

skills.name: Spectral Form
skills.description: Passive: All incoming damage is reduced by 2 (innate resistance from being partially incorporeal).

skills.name: Petrifying Gaze

skills.name: Siren Song
skills.description: Active (once per combat): Charm all players within 8 hexes, forcing them to spend their next turn moving toward the Harpy.

skills.name: Gore Charge
skills.description: Active: Charge 2–5 hexes, deal +6 damage on hit, and shove the target 1 hex back.

skills.name: Revenant Undying
skills.description: Passive: The first time this creature reaches 0 HP, it rises again at half health with renewed fury.

skills.name: Furious Charge
skills.description: Active: Charge an enemy 3-5 hexes away and attack for +4 damage. (10 TP)

skills.name: Fly
skills.description: Active: Take to the air. (1 TP)

skills.name: Land
skills.description: Active: Return to the ground. (1 TP)

skills.name: Companion Brawn

skills.name: Companion Grace

skills.name: Slip Away

skills.name: Acrobatics

skills.name: Second Wind

skills.name: Grit

skills.name: Hardened

skills.name: Unwavering

skills.name: Brace

skills.name: Suppression

skills.name: Rally
skills.description: Active (15 TP): Target an adjacent ally. They immediately gain 10 TP.

skills.name: Press the Advantage

skills.name: Weapon Swap
skills.description: Passive: Switching equipped weapons costs 0 TP.

skills.name: Iron Shirt
skills.description: Passive: Reduce damage received from unarmed attacks by 1.

skills.name: Joint Lock

skills.name: Focused Strike

skills.name: Palm Strike

skills.name: Nerve Strike

skills.name: Redirect

skills.name: Extended Sentence

skills.name: Holy Ground
skills.description: Active (12 TP): Sanctify your current hex for 30 ticks. Enemies entering lose 2 TP per move into the zone; allies ending their turn there regain 1 HP.

skills.name: Armistice
skills.description: Passive: When a trigger spell activates, the attacker must spend 5 extra TP before their next attack (once per activation).

skills.name: Divine Judgment
skills.description: Passive: After being attacked 3 consecutive times without retaliating, your next divine spell costs 0 mana.

skills.name: Barkskin

skills.name: Wild Shape Adaptation
skills.description: Passive: While outdoors (no indoor light penalty), movement costs 1 fewer TP.

skills.name: Nature
skills.description: Passive: Your animal companion acts immediately after your turn completes, regardless of their accumulated TP.

skills.name: Venomous Summon

skills.name: Natural Senses

skills.name: Stonewall

skills.name: Grudge

skills.name: Deep Sense

skills.name: Battle Endurance

skills.name: Keen Hearing

skills.name: Dirty Fighting

skills.name: Trap Setting
skills.description: Active (15 TP): Place a hidden trap on your current hex. The next enemy to step on it triggers a free basic attack at +10% hit chance.
